# SaveEditor.top

> Free, browser-based save file editor for games. All file processing happens client-side — nothing is uploaded.

For full documentation, see: https://saveeditor.top/llms-full.txt

## Supported Engines

- RPG Maker MV/MZ (.rpgsave, .rmmzsave)
- Unity PlayerPrefs (.xml, .plist)
- Ren'Py (.save, persistent)
- Unreal Engine (.sav — standard GVAS)
- GameMaker (.ini, .json)
- NaniNovel (.nson)

## Main Sections

- /: Home — upload any save file, auto-detect engine
- /editor/rpg-maker-mv/: RPG Maker MV/MZ editor
- /editor/unity/: Unity PlayerPrefs editor
- /editor/renpy/: Ren'Py save viewer/editor
- /editor/unreal/: Unreal Engine .sav editor
- /editor/gamemaker/: GameMaker INI/JSON editor
- /editor/naninovel/: NaniNovel .nson editor
- /games/: Browse 80+ supported games
- /blog/: Tutorials and guides
- /faq/: Frequently asked questions
- /saves/: Pre-made save file downloads
- /compatibility/: Engine compatibility matrix

## Supported Languages

- English (default)
- 日本語 (/ja/)
- 한국어 (/ko/)
- Português (/pt/)
- 简体中文 (/zh-cn/)
- Español (/es/)
- Русский (/ru/)

## Privacy

All file parsing and editing happens in the browser via JavaScript/WebAssembly. Save files never leave the user's device.
